This is M4, recurring from rounds 1 and 3 under the byte-identical prompt sha256 bf7db491...; the round-3 NonNegDollars error on line 26 does not recur. This line has no invalid dependency, but triage executed none of the reply, so it is ruled by reading the expression against the source. i8962 pp. 7-8, Line 1: "Your tax family generally includes you, your spouse if you are filing a joint return, and your dependents. If you checked the “Someone can claim you as a dependent” box, or if you are filing jointly and you checked the “Someone can claim your spouse as a dependent” box on your tax return, you or your spouse is not included". M5 does not recur: the candidate now adds the claimed dependents. But it counts only persons with person.sav_claimed false, a Form 8880 question ("Are you claimed as a dependent on someone else's 2025 tax return?") that the project asks only if someone can claim you or your spouse (person.sav_ineligible, forms/2025/person.yaml); such a return is refused by sa.dependent (scope S2), so on every computed return with a Form 1095-A the candidate needs an answer the interview does not ask (M2), and it tests "is claimed" where the source says "can claim". It declares no shown_when, so it shows line 1 on returns without a Form 1095-A (M3).
